text: Based on the evidence, approximately 0.5 hectares of native forest were lost on the property in 2022. This represents about 3.41% of the total asset area. The loss was corroborated by multiple sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map. The native forest loss is part of a larger tree-cover loss event of about 0.6 hectares, with an additional 0.2 hectares of loss in smaller patches that were not counted as part of the main event.
